name: Drush Webmaster: Webform
description: Submodule of Drush Webmaster: wm:webform:* and wm:webform:submission:* Drush commands to list, inspect, export, duplicate and delete webforms and their submissions for AI-assisted site administration.
project_description: Drush Webmaster: Webform is a submodule of Drush Webmaster that adds wm:webform:* and wm:webform:submission:* Drush commands for managing Webform forms and their submissions from the command line, aimed at AI-assisted site administration. It lets an agent or webmaster list webforms with submission counts, inspect a form's elements/handlers/settings, export a form as YAML, duplicate a form, delete a form, and list/get/delete/purge submissions. It depends on the base Drush Webmaster module and the contributed Webform module. This is a 1.0.0-beta1 pre-release.
